Name: Gems and Minerals - Yet Another Rug Recolour (AT or CP)
Author: novust
Description:
[b]Updating?[/b] Please remove entire previous version from your Mods folder and do a clean install! 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/bgxFR4WM/overview.png[/img]

Am I the only one who feels like I never have enough furniture or decor? I didn't think so... 

This mod provides 11 (so far) large rugs that match the most common gems and minerals - Ruby, Topaz, Jade, Emerald, Aquamarine, Amethyst, and Diamond, as well as Quartz, Fire Quartz, Frozen Tear, and Earth Crystal. 

Perfect for a magical, scientific, or nature-y vibe, or to just add something interesting and colourful to a room. 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y7FWbmvc/in-game-requirements.png[/img]

Content Patcher version:  You will need to obtain the Furniture Catalogue from Pierre's.

Aternative Textures version: You will need to acquire the Wizard's Catalogue to obtain the Starry Moon Rug, as well as purchase the Paint Bucket from Robin.

(Or you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url], no judgment! Just search "novust")


[img]https://i.ibb.co/1f42mVfk/installation.png[/img]

• Install the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
• Install the latest version(s) of[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url], depending which version(s) you choose.
• Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods. That's it!
• Safe to add to an existing save.
• To uninstall, simply delete it from your Mods folder. (You may need to delete any rugs you have placed or in your inventory first, to avoid error symbols.)


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Hpk9sGcQ/compatibility.png[/img]

No known conflicts. Please let me know if you find any! 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/GvhKCwBB/mod-recommendations.png[/img]

I strongly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] to be able to place everything [i]precisely[/i] where and how you want to.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/JwPPwY9F/translations.png[/img]

None yet. If you would like to translate my mod into a language you are fluent in, please let me know first, to avoid more than one person working on the same thing.

Once complete, you may upload it independently with my mod as a dependency.

[b]Please no AI translations.[/b]


[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/tdZhGH9/my-other-mods.png[/img]

[/b] •  This is my first official mod! 
•  Before that, a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45895]practice mod [/url]using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43811]this guide[/url]


[img]https://i.ibb.co/gFvr0wMd/what-s-next.png[/img]

Definitely: More rugs, and some furniture and decor too... To start.

Hopefully: [s]Learning how to make Content Patcher versions of my Alternative Textures mods.[/s]  [i]Done[/i]

Maybe even an actual catalogue someday... And, eventually, NPCs/events (I can dream!)
